# DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES

FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION

- If submitting entries electronically through ACS/ABI, hold FDA-2877 in entry file. Do not submit to FDA unless requested.
- If submitting paper entry documents, submit the following to FDA:

DECLARATION FOR IMPORTED

ELECTRONIC PRODUCTS SUBJECT TO RADIATION CONTROL STANDARDS

- 2 copies of Customs Entry Form (e.g. CF 3461, CF 3461 Alt, CF 7501, etc.)
- 1 copy of FDA 2877
- Commercial Invoice(s) in English.

U.S. CUSTOMS PORT OF ENTRY

JFK Airport, New York (4701)

Form Approved OMB No. 0910-0025

Expiration Date: February 28, 2026

INSTRUCTIONS

ENTRY NUMBER

JFK-77820045-3

DATE OF ENTRY

06/03/2026

NAME & ADDRESS OF MANUFACTURING SITE; COUNTRY OF ORIGIN

OptiBeam Lasertechnik GmbH

Industriestrasse 14

76275 Ettlingen

Germany

NAME & ADDRESS OF IMPORTER & ULTIMATE CONSIGNEE (if not importer)

Northeast Photonics Trade Shows LLC

88 Tenth Ave, 4th Floor

New York, NY 10011

USA

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION

QUANTITY (Items/Containers)

Prototype 355 nm UV pulsed laser

6 units / 6 wooden crates

MODEL NUMBER(S) & BRAND NAME(S)

OB-UV355-DemoX (prototype) / Brand: OptiBeam

engraving systems (Class 4) for demonstration only

DECLARATION: I / WE DECLARE THAT THE PRODUCTS IDENTIFIED ABOVE:

(Mark X applicable statements, fill in blanks, & sign)

A. ARE NOT SUBJECT TO RADIATION PERFORMANCE STANDARDS BECAUSE THEY:

- Were manufactured prior to the effective date of any applicable standard; Date of Manufacture
- Are excluded by the applicability clause or definition in the standard or by FDA written guidance. Specify reason for exclusion
- Are personal household goods of an individual entering the U.S. or being returned to a U.S. resident. (Limit: 3 of each product type).
- Are property of a party residing outside the U.S. and will be returned to the owner after repair or servicing.
- Are components or subassemblies to be used in manufacturing or as replacement parts (NOT APPLICABLE to diagnostic x-ray parts).
- Are prototypes intended for on going product development by the importing firm, are labelediFOR TEST/EVALUATION ONLY," and will be exported, destroyed, or held for future testing (i.e., not distributed). (Quantities Limited - see reverse.)

• 7. Are being reprocessed in accordance with P.L. 104-134 or other FDA guidance, are labeled FOR EXPORT ONLY, and will not be sold, distributed, or transferred without FDA approval.

B. COMPLY WITH THE PERFORMANCE STANDARDS WHICH ARE APPLICABLE AT DATE OF MANUFACTURE AND THAT A CERTIFICATION LABEL OR TAG TO THIS EFFECT IS AFFIXED TO EACH PRODUCT. COMPLIANCE DOCUMENTED IN:

- Last annual report or Product/Initial report ACCESSION NUMBER of Report
- Unknown manufacturer or report number; State reason:

Name of MANUFACTURER OF RECORD (Filed report with FDA/CDRH)

X C. DO NOT COMPLY WITH PERFORMANCE STANDARDS; ARE BEING HELD UNDER A TEMPORARY IMPORT BOND; WILL NOT BE INTRODUCED INTO COMMERCE; WILL BE USED UNDER A RADIATION PROTECTION PLAN; AND WILL BE DESTROYED OR EXPORTED UNDER U.S. CUSTOMS SUPERVISION WHEN THE FOLLOWING MISSION IS COMPLETE:

1. Research, Investigations/Studies, or Training (attach Form FDA 766)

X 2. Trade Show/Demonstration; List dates & use restrictions

PhotonExpo NYC, Jun 10-14, 2026; demo only; not for sale; re-export by Jul 1, 2026

D. DO NOT COMPLY WITH PERFORMANCE STANDARDS; ARE HELD AND WILL REMAIN UNDER BOND; AND WILL NOT BE INTRODUCED INTO COMMERCE UNTIL NOTIFICATION IS RECEIVED FROM FDA THAT PRODUCTS HAVE BEEN BROUGHT INTO COMPLIANCE IN ACCORDANCE WITH AN FDA APPROVED PETITION. (See Form FDA 766.)

1. Approved Petition is attached.

• 2. Petition Request is attached.

3. Request will be submitted within 60 days.

SIGNATURE OF IMPORTER OF RECORD

eclaration may be fined not more than $10,000 or imprisonec not more than 5 years or both, pursuant to Title 18 U.S.C.
